Alia Bhatt, Sonam Kapoor Attend Earthshot Prize Event

Actresses Alia Bhatt and Sonam Kapoor attended the Earthshot Prize 2026 event, appearing on a green carpet. Sonam Kapoor's attire for the event was noted as a tribute to Amrita Sher-Gil's 1936 portrait.
